title: No 4-cycle, least top-form AND/OR circuit with one junk AND g: the other input y of a mixing gate reading g fixes what the tops through it carry
formal_statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → G.edgeFinset.Nonempty → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO G C →
  PEqualNP.TopForm.TopForm G C → ∀ (g : ℕ), PEqualNP.TopForm.junk G C = {g} →
    ∀ m ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.mixing G C, n + g ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C m).inputs →
    ∀ y ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C m).inputs, y ≠ n + g →
      (∃ u ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.orIn n C y,
        PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal n C g (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput u u) = false) ∧
      ∀ u ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.orIn n C y, ∀ a ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.tops G C, ∀ t : Fin 2,
        PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C a t) m →
          u ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C a t ∧
          (∀ v w : Fin n, G.Adj v w →
            PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal n C a (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput v w) = true →
            s(v, w) ∉ (PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C a 0 ×ˢ PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C a 1).image
              (fun p => s(p.1, p.2)) →
            PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal n C g (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput v w) = true ∧
            ∃ z ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.wmax G C g, G.Adj u z ∧ (z = v ∨ z = w)) ∧
          (PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C a t = {u} →
            PEqualNP.TopForm.side (n := n) C a (1 - t) ⊆ PEqualNP.TopForm.wmax G C g)
plain_statement: G: an edge, no 4-cycle; C: fewest-gate AND/OR circuit for f_G (1 iff an edge has both ends on), gates read exactly 2 earlier wires, no top inside an AND's cone; top: AND below f_G; g: the only other AND; S(w): inputs w reaches via ORs; m: OR not below f_G reading g, one operand of empty S, other input y; W: z with g AND x_z below f_G; 1_vw: only v, w on. Then g(1_uu) = 0 for some u in S(y); for all u in S(y), tops a, operands t of a reaching m: u is in S(t); each edge vw with a(1_vw) = 1 not across a's sides has g(1_vw) = 1 and an end in W adjacent to u; S(t) = {u} puts the other side in W.
